props.name: view
props._description: Visual style of the button. The names combine emphasis (`normal`, `raised`, `outlined`, `flat`) with a semantic role (`info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `utility`, `action`, `contrast`). `action` is the default primary style.

props.name: icon

iconDisplay.name: iconDisplay
iconDisplay._description: Where the icon is drawn relative to the control's text.

props._description: Icon drawn on the button; the `iconDisplay` sub-prop chooses which side of the caption it sits on.

props.name: disabled
props._description: Greys the button out and blocks its `onClick` event.

props.name: isRecordLevel
props._description: Marks the button as acting on a single record rather than the whole screen — used when the button is rendered inside a table row or repeated group, so each row gets its own instance. (?)

props.name: pin
props._description: Corner shape, written as `left-right`. `round` = fully rounded end, `brick` = square end, `clear` = no visible edge, `circle` = circular end. `round-brick` rounds the left edge and squares the right.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.

props.name: isValidate
props._description: When true, clicking runs the validation rules of the fields in the same container first, and the click event only fires if they all pass. Default is true.
